spec_text:
Build a CLI (validate.mjs) that takes a path to a JSON config, validates it against
an embedded schema (host: string, port: int 1-65535, tls: bool), prints a line per
violation, and exits 1 if any exist, 0 otherwise. Include three node:test cases.
Deliver as a pinned repo: https://github.com/owner/repo@<commit>.
name: JSON config validator
